(module scope)

Builds + initializes the renderer on s. Returns false when the GPU path is disallowed so bootstrap can bail into the CSS fallback; a WebGPU init throw clones the canvas (a canvas that failed context creation is poisoned) and retries with forceWebGL.

  • @param s Engine state bag.
  • @param WebGPURenderer The three/webgpu renderer class.
  • @returns Whether a live renderer was attached.
